markets.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Robert Gasser is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.

If Robert Gasser is a starting pitcher and records at least one batter faced the market will settle based on strikeouts recorded.
